audit.whatIsWrong: content.late writes 'Astral Infusions' (plural) — the ability is 'Astral Infusion' (W), singular, per packet suspectNames and the kit data.
audit.why: Riot's actual name is Astral Infusion; the plural reads as a wrong ability name to a reader who checks it.
audit.corrected: 'chain Astral Infusion casts' instead of 'chain Astral Infusions'.

audit.why: Spikes correctly keyed: level 2 E stun before her W heal comes online, level 6 R execute exploiting her self-damaging kit, first-item lethality outracing Astral Infusion.
Level chart is Pyke-favoured all 7 rows in both layers, consistent with the ~49-50% win rate but strong kill-window advantage: Soraka has no dash, no hard CC before E, and self-damages to heal.

edits.before: Even into items Soraka stays a squishy, immobile single-target healer, so your pick identity never falls off against her. Your R keeps executing her from health totals that would save any other support, and removing her deletes her team's entire sustain engine in a fight. Coordinate your hook and ult with your ADC's burst to blow her up before she can chain Astral Infusions. She only wins if she's allowed to poke uncontested and never gets caught.

edits.before: - Soraka Equinox: matchup-defining — The silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast — step out before the root snaps. It writes your spacing rules. - W Ghostwater Dive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Equinox (E), 20-16s CD: silences then roots if you stay in the zone — step out before it snaps. Your E dash-stun is 15-11s CD; W Ghostwater Dive (14-10s) saves fights, doesn't season trades. R (100-70s) opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
